text:
Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine had 6 white students enrolled in 2024-25
Six white students were enrolled at Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine in the 2024-25 school year, matching the count from the previous year, according to the Michigan Department of Education.
Benjamin Carson High School of Science and Medicine enrolled 191 students in the 2024-25 school year. White students made up 3.1% of the student body, the third-largest ethnic group at the school. African American students were the largest group, representing 89% (170) of enrollment.
The school is part of Detroit Public Schools Community District District and has a central office in Detroit.
Of the 103 schools in Detroit Public Schools Community District District, Priest Elementary-Middle School had the highest white student enrollment in the 2024-25 school year.
Michigan’s 2026 education budget totals $24.1 billion, with $19.5 billion coming from the School Aid Fund. It set per-pupil funding at $10,050, a 4.6% increase from the previous year. The budget kept free school meals and provided full funding for pre-K and community college.
